WITH channel_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_orders
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT 
  orderbase AS channel,
  avg_fillcount,
  distinct_orders,
  CAST(distinct_orders AS NUMERIC) / SUM(distinct_orders) OVER () AS fraction
FROM channel_stats
ORDER BY orderbase;
